description:
The household’s physical helper comes from the Makuhita/Hariyama line. Maku’s affection and clumsy care are individual characterization, not a claim that every Makuhita shares his household habits.

A physical alternative to Wick and Pookie; the early move access must allow meaningful participation against spectral enemies.
